note: Every file under main game/public/assets/chronicles. Textures are regenerated deterministically by the command shown; the Quest copies are mirrored by syncMenuAssets during the Quest build and are not committed.

files.source: The creator's painted map of the four nations (2048 x 1529), supplied for Brief E and first delivered as assets/home/chronicles.webp. The central tower was removed by orchestrator inpainting (creator decision, 29 October 2026; working choice). Used unmodified as the relief's albedo; never redrawn.
